_bug: EARLIER DRAFT - solver used a continuous fuel model (any load -> proportional fuel), which violated the step-function nature of the diesel generator.

_expected_fixed.note: Actual demand 6 kW falls in the 6 kW tier (0.9 L/h in the old table) or the top tier in this fixture (1.4 L/h). The fix replaces the continuous model with a discrete tier-selection variable z[k, t] + load-in-bracket constraint.

_what_was_wrong: Continuous model let the generator draw fractional fuel for fractional loads, which is physically wrong for a step-function generator. Worse, it let the solver choose loads that would never correspond to a real fuel curve, producing underestimates that would have been caught only at the pump.
